missions.name: Missions Tab v1
missions.brief: Kanban surface for technical multi-PR initiatives. Read-only v1; phase derived from chain_events + PR state.

missions.name: Programs Kanban (drag-drop projects)
missions.brief: Switch Programs view to kanban + drag-drop per E4.4b spec.
missions.deferred_reason: Prioritized Missions tab first per 2026-05-28 design pass

missions.name: Operator Action Queue
missions.brief: New panel on Missions tab collecting every chain state requiring operator action (approvals, paused sequences, dispatched-but-stuck steps, CLARIFY-exhausted PRs, NOW-severity alerts) with copy-paste commands. Closes the bootstrap-003 skip-window gap class.

missions.name: Tiered Telegram Alert Taxonomy (NOW / SOON / FYI)
missions.brief: Add tier field to alert-translations.json so each subject maps to NOW (blocks chain), SOON (within hours), FYI (informational). DM rendering surfaces tier visually. Reduces operator fatigue from undifferentiated alerts.

missions.name: Claude-as-Forge Rescue Runbook + Dashboard Trigger
missions.brief: Document the out-of-chain manual rescue path operator uses when chain CLARIFY-exhausts (test-isolation-v3, Missions PR-A, fixture-gate #169 patterns). Add Missions-tab card affordance to trigger rescue. Closes tribal-knowledge gap.

missions.name: Beacon catch-me-up Telegram shortcut
missions.brief: Single Telegram command (e.g. 'catch me up' / 'status') that returns structured since-last-checkpoint summary: merged PRs + open PRs + pending approvals + active alerts + sequence state. Eliminates 5+ refetch round-trips per check-in.

missions.name: Structured gap-log field on sequence files
missions.brief: Add gap_log: [{ts, severity, finding, surfaced_by}] field to build-sequence schema. Verifier specs (bootstrap-N) populate it during run. Missions tab renders the log; cross-sequence search becomes possible.

missions.name: CLARIFY round visibility on Missions cards
missions.brief: Surface the Forge↔Beacon CLARIFY round-trip Q&A on Missions-tab card side-panel. Today the operator only learns CLARIFY-exhausted post-mortem from logs. Read-only v1; later optional 'intervene' affordance.
missions.deferred_reason: Superseded by clarify-round-visibility mission (full Q+A scope) per 2026-05-29 design pass. Stub spec only contemplated question-side; complete feature lives in agents/beacon/specs/clarify-round-visibility.md.

missions.name: CLARIFY round visibility — full Q+A on Missions cards
missions.brief: Render the full Forge↔Beacon CLARIFY round-trip (questions AND answers) on Missions tab side-panel. Supersedes stub operator-ux-clarify-visibility (answer side gap surfaced 2026-05-29). 2-step sequence: agent-core chain_event_shipper extension + dashboard ClarifyRoundDrawer component.

missions.name: Pulse Cycle Upgrade (alpha / beta / gamma sequence)
missions.brief: Four-PR sequence implementing the self-optimizing operational config via Pulse Check pattern (design pass 2026-05-26). alpha-1 + alpha-2 + beta + gamma. Critical-path destination for the chain.

missions.name: Rate-limit resilience sequence (001)
missions.brief: Sequence hardening the chain against Anthropic rate-limit windows (the 5h burn-rate gate plus Tier 1/Tier 2 OAuth fallback boundaries).

missions.name: PM dashboard project due_date column
missions.brief: Add projects.due_date column to Supabase + expose on dashboard API (agent-core PR #23 shipped 2026-05-30).

missions.name: Missions Proposed-Lane Signal Hardening
missions.brief: Make the auto-proposed missions lane a short, self-cleaning decision queue. Filter non-buildable orphan categories (chain-incident/alert artifacts, desktop captures, sequence-step proposals, translation/rule/dated-digest artifacts, stale test-fixtures) at proposal time via a shared is_proposable_initiative predicate; retire-with-audit any proposed entry whose orphan is terminal or no longer passes the filter (additive acknowledged flag, phase stays proposed, never hard-deleted); the retirement pass reconciles the existing 128-entry backlog on the first post-merge run and the run log reports the surviving proposed ids.
